author: Fextralife
description:
Path of Exile 2 Spirit Walker Build - Lightning Spear Huntress (Update 0.5)
In this Path of Exile 2 video, I'm going to be showing you my Lightning Spear Huntress build. This is a build using the new Spirit Walker Ascendancy that was added with 0.5 update of the game. I just want to show you what's been working for me as I play through the campaign with this ascendancy. And it's not an end game build or anything like that, it's kind of to help you get started into the new league and find your way forward.
